#!/usr/bin/env bash
# An API-key login's helper, as the engine writes it, written out (R1264c D3; a variable in it is refused: R1264e/f D2), and the empty settings.
claude -p hi --settings "{\"apiKeyHelper\":\"cat -- /home/user/.config/key\"}" --setting-sources '' --strict-mcp-config
claude -p hi --settings '{}' --setting-sources '' --strict-mcp-config
